first_destructive_statement.text: psql "$SUPER_URL" -X -qAt -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $DB WITH (FORCE)" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ${DB}_lock WITH (FORCE)" -c "CREATE DATABASE $DB" >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG" || { echo "cannot create db"; exit 1; }

fresh_connection_timeout_assertions.text: check "DB2: session timeout settings did not leak (fresh connection shows defaults)" "0|0" "$(q "$PG2_URL" "select current_setting('lock_timeout')||'|'||current_setting('statement_timeout')")"
check "timeouts RESET at end of migration (fresh session defaults)" "0|0" "$(q "$PG_URL" "select current_setting('lock_timeout')||'|'||current_setting('statement_timeout')")"

lock_target.text: psql "$PG2_URL" -X -qAt -c "begin; select 1 from \"DunningAttempt\" limit 1; select pg_sleep(25);" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
